resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "reviewer" {
  role = "agent-platform-github-ci-branch"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = ["logs:PutLogEvents", "s3:GetObject", "s3:${var.SENTINEL_INTERP_ACTION}"]
        Resource = ["arn:aws:s3:::${var.SENTINEL_RESOURCE}/*"]
      },
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_lambda_permission" "events" {
  statement_id  = "AllowEvents"
  action        = "lambda:InvokeFunction"
  function_name = "agent-platform-${var.SENTINEL_NAME}"
  principal     = "events.amazonaws.com"
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "logs" {
  bucket = "${var.SENTINEL_BUCKET}"
}
